latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of video editing with OpenShot via AI-assisted cloud backend.

- Seamless AI-assisted video editing: upload raw clips, describe edits, and receive polished MP4s in minutes.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV inputs up to 500MB; additional support for common audio/image formats.
- Automatic first-time setup and authentication, with credits tracking and session management.
- Handles common edit actions: trimming, adding transitions, overlays, audio, export, and more — all by prompt.
- Clear error handling, quick feedback, and “Ready!” workflow messages for user confidence.
- Ideal for creators and students wanting fast results without complex software.
